metadata.suitability: Source-only inventory, NOT a map or address-to-ED drive time ranking
caveats: CMS list includes registered Medicare hospitals and omits some freestanding ED, urgent care and other facilities.
Emergency-services Yes is not proof of 24/7 operations, current hours or ED clinical capabilities.
Trauma designation is a separate Texas DSHS source requiring verified facility identity matches.
Facility coordinates and actual driving time were not acquired; never label straight-line distance as driving time.
Retain source vintage and check closures/updates before publishing.
